reference: Mean of eight transformed OBB vertices is simulator BoxCenter; not Actor origin/render surface/contact. Inverse actor transform recovers local bbox orientation/center. Frame joins and static between-ticks acquisition required.

matching.train: one-to-one unmerged unsplit matched candidate only; no GT feature input

features: Frozen Mobile fusedP8 mask-bbox3x3 sampled grid (576) + legal K/T/region geometry (24); inference noGT. Companion geometry-only prior same data/order.

training.loss: Huber(logZ) + Huber(normalized projected-center offset), equal weights; no NLL
training.selection: Val position-macro XY MAE minimum; no budget extension
training.stop: nonfinite loss/gradient abort; insufficient support skip

calibration.method: Posthoc ridge logXYerror from legal predicted logZ, RGB component shape, predicted UV offset; leave-one-position-out Val diagnostics; final allVal fit only for sealed. Empirical90% radius, no conformal guarantee.
calibration.comparison: same accepted targets: MAE and P95 must improve over Plane AND DenseExpected AND DenseMode; both seeds
calibration.no_qualification: keep threshold0 research estimates, never VerifiedContact; no new training

splits: K train/val + M dev original splits (6positions each), K/L/M oldtests regression only. Actor IDs reused across worlds not identities; group-based exclusion.

sealed.layouts: empty, near/mid/far car, side/rear, pedestrian, occlusion, cone, truncation/overlap; captured after freeze

runtime: offline GPU only; M5M Partial inherited, no shadow matrix/control
